# Paste the incident log. Get the postmortem draft.

> Paste an incident log and get time to detect, acknowledge, mitigate and resolve plus a blameless postmortem draft in Markdown. Free incident timeline generator and MTTR calculator, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/incident-postmortem-timeline/)
- [How to write a blameless postmortem from a timeline](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/incident-postmortem-timeline/how-to-write-a-blameless-postmortem.html)
